english.title: Misconduct of master / crew likely to endanger ships / structures / individuals
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the master of]_
(B)_[a seaman employed in]_

**(..SPECIFY SHIP..),

(C)_[a United Kingdom ship,]_
(D)_[a ship which was registered under the law of **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY OUTSIDE THE UNITED KINGDOM..) and was in a United Kingdom port, namely **(..SPECIFY UK PORT..),]_
(E)_[a ship which was registered under the law of **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY OUTSIDE THE UNITED KINGDOM..) and was within United Kingdom waters while proceeding to a United Kingdom port, namely **(..SPECIFY UK PORT..),]_
(F)_[a ship which was registered under the law of **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY OUTSIDE THE UNITED KINGDOM..) and was within United Kingdom waters while proceeding from a United Kingdom port, namely **(..SPECIFY UK PORT..),]_

while on board the ship or in its immediate vicinity, did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), which caused or was likely to have caused

(G)_[the loss or destruction of or serious damage to your ship or its machinery, navigational equipment or safety equipment]_
(H)_[the loss or destruction of or serious damage to another ship, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER SHIP..)]_
(I)_[the loss or destruction of or serious damage to a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..)]_
(J)_[the death or serious injury to a person]_

(K)_[that act being deliberate]_
(L)_[that act amounting to a breach or neglect of duty]_
(M)_[you being under the influence of drink or a drug at the time of the act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58(2)(a) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 58(6) provides defences to this offence.
(ii) Note that a master or seaman referred to in options (D), (E) or (F) of the above wording cannot commit an offence as outlined in option (G) of the wording, see section 58(7).
(iii) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Secretary of State or the Director of Public Prosecutions, see section 58(7).
(iv) Article 6 of the Merchant Shipping (Watercraft) Order 2023 provides for the application of section 58 to watercraft. This ensures that the offences in section 58 apply to users of watercraft as they do in relation to ships; for the offence wording see H101279.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
